ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is a sea-level isobar distribution map of a certain region, marked with the latitude lines 60° and 70° and the 180° meridian. ① is located on the right side of the figure, near the 60° latitude line; ② is located on the lower-left side of the figure, and its position is farther south than ③; ③ is located slightly left of the middle of the figure, near the 70° latitude line, and is the place with the highest latitude among the three places. Then reason: The annual variation range of day length is mainly affected by latitude; the higher the latitude, the greater the variation range of day length in a year. Among the three places, place ③ has the highest latitude, so the annual variation range of day length at place ③ is greater than at places ① and ②.

raw_record.question_text:
The following figure schematically shows the sea-level isobar distribution in a certain region at a certain time. Read the figure and answer: Among places ①, ②, and ③ in the figure, which place has an annual variation range of day length greater than the other two places?

<image1>

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：图中有纬线标注60°、70°，①、②、③分别标在北太平洋及其周边区域，③位于70°纬线附近，①接近60°纬线，②比③更偏南。再推理：题目要求比较三地昼长年内变化幅度，只需比较纬度高低；纬度越高，昼长年变化幅度越大。因此三地中纬度最高的③地昼长年内变化幅度最大，答案为③地。
method.CoT_raw:
先描述图像：图中是某区域海平面等压线分布图，标有纬线60°、70°以及180°经线。①位于图右侧，靠近60°纬线附近；②位于图左下侧，位置比③偏南；③位于图中部偏左，接近70°纬线附近，是三地中纬度最高的地点。
再推理：昼长年内变化幅度主要受纬度影响，纬度越高，一年中昼长变化幅度越大。三地中③地纬度最高，所以③地昼长年内变化幅度大于①、②两地。

再推理：昼长年内变化幅度主要受纬度影响，纬度越高，一年中昼长变化幅度越大。三地中③地纬度最高，所以③地昼长年内变化幅度大于①、②两地。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: This route uses the graticule labels as a direct latitude lookup, then applies the standard latitude-daylength relation. It is the most straightforward map-reading method.
planner_metadata.image_role: Read the latitude graticule on the map: the curved parallels labeled 60° and 70° show that ③ is closest to/near 70°N, while ① is around the 60°N side and ② is farther south than ③. Thus ③ has the highest latitude among the three marked sites.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the wording “昼长年内变化幅度大于另外两地” to identify that the task is not about pressure or weather, but about comparing the three locations’ latitudes.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Annual amplitude of day length increases with absolute latitude: places nearer the pole have larger seasonal day-length variation than lower-latitude places.

再推理：昼长年内变化幅度主要随纬度变化，纬度越高，太阳直射点季节移动造成的昼夜长短变化越明显，接近极圈还会出现极昼、极夜现象。因此只需比较三地纬度高低，③地纬度最高，昼长年内变化幅度最大。
